# List Challenges

> > A community-driven checklist platform with 311,153+ curated lists spanning movies, travel destinations, music albums, books, and pop culture challenges.

List Challenges enables users to create, share, and track progress on themed checklists across entertainment, travel, and lifestyle categories. The platform features both user-generated and editorial content, with popular collections covering Disney/Pixar filmographies, Italian travel destinations, color-themed music albums, and animated movie marathons.

## Platform Overview

- [List Challenges](https://www.listchallenges.com/): Homepage for checklist platform with 311,153+ lists on movies, travel, books

## Movie & Animation Checklists

- [All Disney & Pixar Animated Movies](https://www.listchallenges.com/all-disney-and-pixar-animated-movies): Complete Disney canon and Pixar filmography checklist from Snow White onward
- [100 Random Animated Movie Challenge!](https://www.listchallenges.com/100-random-animated-movie-challenge): User-created animated movie checklist featuring Toy Story series and more

## Travel & Destination Guides

- [50 Must-Visit Cities in Italy](https://www.listchallenges.com/50-must-visit-cities-in-italy): Travel checklist of 50 Italian cities including Milan, Turin, and Portofino

## Music Album Collections

- [Albums With Red Covers](https://www.listchallenges.com/albums-with-red-covers): Music album checklist featuring red cover art across multiple genres
- [Albums With Orange Covers](https://www.listchallenges.com/albums-with-orange-covers): Color-themed music list of albums with orange cover artwork
